plan.title: Substrate Phase 4: one liveness oracle; no placeholders; no inferred identity
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: Four different liveness predicates disagree (tmux session, pane dead, harness process, mirror label), so a remain-on-exit zombie pane looks alive to feedback routing and a working agent looks idle to the nudge patrol. Spawn writes a pending-work-spawn row that a reconciliation patrol must clean up, and session recovery adopts a transcript by directory listing when exactly one file exists, which is how a planner transcript was attributed to a work agent.
narratives.Proposal: Create src/lib/agents/liveness.ts as the single oracle with a lint guard, have the PTY supervisor emit lifecycle events that the projection writes in one transaction, replace the start row with an in-process in-flight set, stop adopting transcripts by listing, audit, then delete the liveness flips and the Phase 4 patrols behind the soak; document.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to how non-supervisor (tmux-only) agents are launched.
- No change to the boot-time crash recovery role of handleAgentHeartbeatDeadEvent.
- No new dashboard UI; only the lifecycle route.

metadata.sizeJustification: Phase of epic PAN-3845; the work items are the PRD work items and cannot be split without losing the audit-before-delete ordering. Subsystem count is inflated by single docs files (each counts as its own subsystem).

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W32 in drafts/pan-3849.md. Create src/lib/agents/liveness.ts exporting LivenessVerdict, isAlive, isAliveSync, isIdle and idleAgeMs built from sessionExists (tmux.ts:1097), isPaneDead and hasAgentRuntimeInSubtree (messaging.ts:597); move the w5 idle helpers here. Replace each private liveness definition in deacon-auto-resume.ts (queryConfirmedSession, handleAgentStoppedEvent), parked/resolver.ts:461, feedback-target.ts isLiveSession, work-agent-lifecycle.ts:102 and messaging.ts:596-612 with the module functions. Add scripts/lint-liveness.sh modelled on lint-pipeline-membership.sh that fails on sessionExists(, sessionExistsSync( or pane_dead outside liveness.ts, tmux.ts and tests, and wire it into npm run lint.

items.title: Given no tmux session, when isAlive runs, then it returns alive false with reason no-session.
Given a session with a dead pane it returns pane-dead, given a live pane with no harness process it returns runtime-missing, and given all present, when isAlive runs, then it returns alive true.
When bash scripts/lint-liveness.sh runs on the tree, then it exits 0, and with --self-test it detects a seeded violation.
Given a remain-on-exit zombie pane, when feedback-target isLiveSession runs, then it returns false.
The PTY supervisor emits lifecycle events; the projection writes state from them

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W33 in drafts/pan-3849.md. Add the route under src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/ and register it; it calls one projection function applyAgentLifecycleEvent that writes state.json and the agents row in one transaction (saveAgentStateAndEmitEventWithDeps, agent-projection.ts:148-170). Restrict handleAgentHeartbeatDeadEvent to the boot-time call from startDeacon.

items.title: Given an exited event with a valid pty-token, when POST /api/agents/:id/lifecycle runs, then state.json status is stopped and the agents row agrees.
Given a missing or invalid token, when the route is called, then it returns 401.
Given the dashboard is unreachable, when the supervisor child exits, then it retries the POST three times with backoff under fake timers and never blocks the child.
Given a reviewer exits in a fixture, when only the supervisor event path runs, then its state reads stopped.
Replace the pending-work-spawn start row with an in-process in-flight set
